method.filtering_summary: Of about 1,060 postings pulled, about 150 were more than 30 days old, about 250 had senior, lead or manager titles, about 400 weren’t target roles, and most of the rest were limited to the US, EU or LATAM, or to time zones that exclude UTC+3.
